name: Polymarket book-depth conviction regime — long crypto when prediction-market liquidity is deep
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (uses pm_book_depth, a feature NO inbox spec touches, and a different channel from polymarket-positioning-risk-flip [the odds LEVEL] and polymarket-prob-velocity [the odds SPEED]): the depth of a prediction market's order book (pm_book_depth, bounded ~0.25-2.0) is a liquidity/conviction gauge — a DEEP book means informed capital is willing to size into the risk view at tight spreads (conviction, orderly risk appetite), while a THIN book signals uncertainty and fragility where participants pull liquidity ahead of a shock. Deep prediction-market liquidity is thus a cross-market 'risk is orderly' tag: crypto, the highest-beta risk asset, tends to trend cleanly when the macro/event book is deep and chop or gap when it is thin. Conditioning a crypto long on a deep-enough book filters out the fragile, illiquid risk regimes. Entry: pm_book_depth above a fitted depth floor (orderly, liquid risk regime) AND price in a non-broken uptrend. Exit: pm_book_depth crosses DOWN through a thinning threshold (liquidity withdrawing — fragility rising) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if the unconditional trend long matches the deflated Sharpe, the depth gate adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: book depth may just track overall market activity already in vol_realized; if a vol_realized gate does as well this carries no orthogonal liquidity information. Disconfirmer 3 (data depth + breadth): only ~400 points, single aggregate market (market-wide, not per-symbol) — low-confidence, paper-only until it deepens. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): must clear ~20bps round-trip net. tier0 prediction-market feature.
catalyst: deep prediction-market liquidity — an orderly, high-conviction risk regime for a crypto long
